queries.query:
commVoltageRec =
  from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
    |> range(start: -inf)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTM2.powerStatus" and
      r._field == "commVoltage"
    )
    |> last()
    |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)


from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -inf)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTM2.logevent_closedLoopControlMode" and
    r._field == "mode"
  )
  |> last() // Get the most recent mode
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      commVoltage: float(v: commVoltageRec._value),
      description:
        if float(v: commVoltageRec._value) < 20.0 then "IDLE (power off)"
        else if r._value == 1.00 then "Idle"
        else if r._value == 2.00 then "TELEMETRY ONLY"
        else if r._value == 3.00 then "OPEN LOOP"
        else if r._value == 4.00 then "CLOSED LOOP"
        else "UNKNOWN"
    }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "commVoltage", "description"])

queries.query:
// Obtener el último valor de commVoltage del MTM2
lastCommVoltage = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: dashboardTime, stop: upperDashboardTime)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTM2.powerStatus" and
    r._field == "commVoltage"
  )
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last_commVoltage")  // Opcional para depuración
